about: Hand-authored ground truth for the demo clip. Kept apart from
expected_violations.json on purpose: that file is generated by
scripts/generate_demo_audio.py and is overwritten whenever the clip is
re-rendered, so a label written into it would not survive. This file holds
only the judgements - what each line is, and whether it should be flagged -
and joins to the generated offsets by line/pause index.

income-claim.description: A specific earnings figure presented as a result of the opportunity.

lifestyle-claim.description: A quit-your-job or luxury-purchase result attributed to the opportunity.

health-claim.description: A product credited with treating or curing a medical condition.

dead-air.description: A planted pause with nothing audible in it.

non-english.description: A code-switch into another language mid-conversation.

claims-and-scrub.description: The demo prompt: the three claim types plus the deterministic scrubber.
claims-and-scrub.prompt: Find every income, lifestyle, and health claim, then cut the filler words and dead air

scrub.description: The deterministic detectors alone: filler words and dead air, no LLM.

pii-redaction.description: The pii-redaction preset: spoken contact details, muted rather than cut.

expectations.note: Not in the audio. The TTS call for line 9 returned 0.3s of silence and the generator recorded that as the line's duration, so the clip skips from the third pause straight to the email line. Excluded from scoring until the fixture is re-rendered; scoring it would report a miss that no detector could ever have avoided.

expectations.quote: grow dot spark at lumenrise dash living dot com

expectations.note: On the silent line 9 - see phone-number-1.
On the silent line 9 - see phone-number-1.

Not a planted pause. The TTS clip for line 7 ends before its measured slot does and line 8 starts half a second into its own, leaving 1.01s below -50 dBFS across the seam - `ffmpeg -af silencedetect=n=-50dB:d=0.75` reports 53.879 -> 54.892. That is dead air by every definition the tool uses, so a correct detector finds it and the labels say so rather than scoring it as a hallucination. It is named as a line span because the generated offsets record slots, and this silence has no slot of its own. seed_job.json predates DEAD_AIR_MIN_SECONDS coming down to 0.75s, so the recorded run misses it.

controls.reason: An explicit earnings disclaimer sitting between the income claims. Flagging it means the analyzer has fallen back to matching on the neighbourhood - money words next to success words - instead of reading what the sentence says.
A neutral question with no claim in it, placed immediately after the income claim. It shares the topic and none of the substance.
